message.content: {"facts":{"Z01":{"en":"The synchronous returned arrow creates ctx with async: false.","pt-BR":"A arrow síncrona retornada cria ctx com async: false."},"Z02":{"en":"The synchronous arrow calls schema._zod.run with { value, issues: [] } and ctx.","pt-BR":"A arrow síncrona chama schema._zod.run com { value, issues: [] } e ctx."},"Z03":{"en":"The synchronous arrow explicitly throws core.$ZodAsyncError under result instanceof Promise.","pt-BR":"A arrow síncrona lança explicitamente core.$ZodAsyncError sob result instanceof Promise."},"Z04":{"en":"At the normal return, truthy result.issues.length selects failure.","pt-BR":"No retorno normal, result.issues.length truthy seleciona failure."},"Z05":{"en":"At the normal return with no issues, the literal has success: true.","pt-BR":"No retorno normal sem issues, o literal tem success: true."},"Z06":{"en":"The error getter construction branch is guarded by !error.","pt-BR":"O ramo de construção no getter de error é condicionado por !error."},"Z07":{"en":"The error setter assigns e to the local error.","pt-BR":"O setter de error atribui e à variável local error."},"Z08":{"en":"The asynchronous arrow awaits result when result instanceof Promise.","pt-BR":"A arrow assíncrona aguarda result quando result instanceof Promise."},"Z09":{"en":"The core safeParse binding supplies errors.$ZodRealError to _safeParse.","pt-BR":"O vínculo safeParse do core fornece errors.$ZodRealError a _safeParse."},"Z10":{"en":"At the normal return with no issues, the literal has data: result.value.","pt-BR":"No retorno normal sem issues, o literal tem data: result.value."}} }
